# Workday

Workday may be the system of record while another implementation partner (such as KPMG) owns the actual integration work — confirm ownership first.

## Handling

- Workday can be used as a vendor, but it is often the client's software with another company involved in the integration.
- Workday can take standard outbound files with or without separate catch-up contributions.
- Some cases require custom files for loans.
- Loan handling usually uses Transamerica loan numbers, except custom loan files may use vendor loan numbers.
- PGP may apply in some Workday situations — confirm security requirements early.
